responsibility: Implements HTML emission for diagnostics as a concrete diagnostics::sink. This file builds XHTML documents for reported diagnostics, manages HTML-specific buffering, turns messages, metadata, patches, paths, digraphs, and optional state-diagram material into XML/HTML elements, opens .html output files, and flushes completed documents to disk; it is the HTML format backend, distinct from the plain text and SARIF sink implementations.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the HTML sink pair: it contains the concrete XHTML-emitting sink classes, document/buffer builders, file-opening logic, and selftests, whereas html-sink.h only declares the HTML generation options and public factory/printing entry points used by other diagnostics code.
